mapper.sql: L.LOST_TPOF_SN , L.PST_SN , L.RGN_SN , L.PET_SE_CD , L.LOST_TPOF_STTS_CD , L.PET_NM , L.COLR_NM , L.CNPL_ENC , L.WTNS_PLC_LAT , L.WTNS_PLC_LOT , L.PSTG_PRD_UPDT_NMTM , L.LAST_WTNS_DT , L.EXPRY_CRTR_DT , L.DSCV_SWTC_DT , L.WTNS_PLC_NM , L.PRVC_RLS_AGRE_YN , L.REG_DT , L.MDFCN_DT , L.VRTY_SN , L.VRTY_DRCT_INPT_NM , L.CHRC_CN
mapper.select:
SELECT L.LOST_TPOF_SN , P.PST_TTL , L.LOST_TPOF_STTS_CD , L.DSCV_SWTC_DT , P.REG_DT , CASE WHEN THEN NULL ELSE L.PET_SE_CD END AS PET_SE_CD , CASE WHEN THEN NULL ELSE L.PET_NM END AS PET_NM , CASE WHEN THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(V.VRTY_NM, L.VRTY_DRCT_INPT_NM) END AS VRTY_NM , CASE WHEN THEN NULL ELSE END AS RGN_NM , CASE WHEN THEN NULL ELSE L.COLR_NM END AS COLR_NM , CASE WHEN THEN NULL ELSE L.CHRC_CN END AS CHRC_CN , CASE WHEN THEN NULL ELSE (SELECT I.ATCH_FILE_SN FROM PST_IMG I WHERE I.PST_SN = L.PST_SN AND I.DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY I.SORT_SEQ, I.PST_IMG_SN LIMIT 1) END AS THUMB_ATCH_FILE_SN FROM LOST_TPOF L JOIN PST P ON P.PST_SN = L.PST_SN JOIN RGN R ON R.RGN_SN = L.RGN_SN LEFT JOIN VRTY V ON V.VRTY_SN = L.VRTY_SN WHERE P.PST_STTS_CD = #{pstSttsCd} AND (L.LOST_TPOF_STTS_CD = #{foundCd} OR (L.LOST_TPOF_STTS_CD = #{missingCd} AND L.EXPRY_CRTR_DT >= NOW()))
AND L.LOST_TPOF_STTS_CD = #{lostTpofSttsCd}
AND L.RGN_SN IN (WITH RECURSIVE T AS (SELECT RGN_SN FROM RGN WHERE RGN_SN = #{rgnSn} UNION ALL SELECT C.RGN_SN FROM RGN C JOIN T ON C.UP_RGN_SN = T.RGN_SN) SELECT RGN_SN FROM T)
AND L.PET_SE_CD = #{petSeCd}
AND L.LAST_WTNS_DT >= CURDATE()
AND L.LAST_WTNS_DT >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
AND L.LAST_WTNS_DT >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)
AND L.LAST_WTNS_DT < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)
AND ( LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR V.VRTY_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR L.VRTY_DRCT_INPT_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR L.CHRC_CN LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY CASE WHEN L.LOST_TPOF_STTS_CD = #{foundCd} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END , P.REG_DT DESC , L.LOST_TPOF_SN DESC

SELECT , P.MBR_SN , M.MBR_NCNM , P.PST_STTS_CD , P.PST_TTL , P.PST_CN , P.INQ_CNT , P.RCMDTN_CNT , P.REG_DT AS PST_REG_DT , V.VRTY_NM , AS RGN_NM FROM LOST_TPOF L JOIN PST P ON P.PST_SN = L.PST_SN JOIN MBR M ON M.MBR_SN = P.MBR_SN JOIN RGN R ON R.RGN_SN = L.RGN_SN LEFT JOIN VRTY V ON V.VRTY_SN = L.VRTY_SN WHERE L.LOST_TPOF_SN = #{lostTpofSn} AND P.PST_STTS_CD = #{pstSttsCd}
mapper.update: UPDATE LOST_TPOF SET EXPRY_CRTR_DT = DATE_ADD(EXPRY_CRTR_DT, INTERVAL 30 DAY) , PSTG_PRD_UPDT_NMTM = PSTG_PRD_UPDT_NMTM + 1 , MDFCN_DT = NOW() WHERE LOST_TPOF_SN = #{lostTpofSn} AND LOST_TPOF_STTS_CD = #{missingCd} AND NOW() >= DATE_SUB(EXPRY_CRTR_DT, INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND NOW() <= EXPRY_CRTR_DT
